title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v11: Map 2 floor width follows the actual viewport frustum, cylinder rows are sparser/staggered, far cylinders darken more strongly, and stretched checker textures on columns were replaced by solid shaded violet materials.

open_feedback: Review Map 2 floor on portrait and wide desktop: it should cover the full visible width with no exposed side gaps.
Review cylinder spacing: near/mid/far groups should read as separate depth layers rather than one dense wall.
Review far-cylinder darkening and solid shading for stronger depth and roundness.
Preserve fixed frontal view and forward/back-only movement.
